typography.strategy: High legibility, modern sans-serif. The 'Old Money Tech' approach—sterile, exact, trustworthy. Headings use 'Outfit' with tight tracking, Body uses 'Manrope' for precise data reading.

colors.strategy: Authoritative Calm. Warm off-white background with deep navy text for high contrast without clinical harshness. Accent blue for interactive elements. Semantic colors strictly for status states (Success, Warning, Error).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist 'Crisp' shadows. Ambient shadow: shadow-sm, Hover state: shadow-md. Do not over-use heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-neutral-200/border-slate-200) on cards. Avoid thick borders. Use Technical Grid Borders where data is dense.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for main containers, rounded-md for inner elements. Avoid fully rounded pill shapes except for badges/tags.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Strictly limited. Do not use for generic cards. Can be used for sticky headers or AI panels: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-neutral-200.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, flat colors. Minimal subtle noise allowed on deep navy surfaces only. Keep the off-white background matte and pristine.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_landing: Tetris Grid. Wide constraints (max-w-7xl). Asymmetrical bento layouts for features. Generous padding (py-24, py-32).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_app: Desktop-first persistent left sidebar (w-64) + main content area. High Density Grid (gap-6) for data and overview cards. Max width for app content is constrained for readability (max-w-6xl mx-auto).
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-4 for small cards, p-6 or p-8 for main sections. Use padding aggressively to give elements breathing room.

components.buttons: Flat solid backgrounds. Hover states should translate-y-[-1px] and slightly deepen the color. Primary buttons in Accent Blue.
components.cards: White surface (bg-white) with 1px border (border-neutral-200) and no shadow by default. On hover, shadow-sm.
components.timeline: Horizontal pipeline design. Use semantic colors for states (Green=Verified, Amber=Processing). Clear node connections.
components.forms: Inputs with flat backgrounds, 1px borders, subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500).
components.sidebar: Persistent left sidebar. Off-white background (bg-[#FDFDF9]) with subtle border-r (border-neutral-200) to blend seamlessly with the app, using Navy text for active states.
components.badges: Pill-shaped, using low-opacity backgrounds with high-contrast text (e.g., bg-amber-50 text-amber-700).

motion.interactions: Fast and purposeful. 150ms-200ms ease-out transitions for hovers.
motion.page_load: Subtle fade and slide-up (translate-y-2 to 0, opacity 0 to 1) for main sections.
motion.timeline_progress: Animate the width of the connecting line in horizontal timelines on scroll or load using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against off-white meets 4.5:1 ratio. Avoid light gray text on white. Use text-secondary (#4B5563).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

avatar_rahul.description: Professional Indian man smiling in a suit. Use for 'Rahul Sharma' demo account avatar.

landing_hero_accent.description: Clean, minimal modern architecture. Use sparingly as a subtle background or masked image in the marketing hero section to convey 'structure and resolution'.

abstract_texture.description: Minimal abstract blue texture. Use behind AI explanation panels or resolution cards to give a subtle 'AI-powered' feel without being flashy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js and .jsx files for React components since the environment is JS-based, not TS-based.
Build the application specifically for Desktop screens (1280px+). Sidebars and side panels must be persistent.
Ensure 'PF Resolve' feels like a high-end fintech product (like Stripe/Linear), not a generic SaaS or old government portal. Rely heavily on exact typography and spacing over colors.
Do not use mobile app patterns on desktop (e.g., no bottom tab bars).
Implement the 'Prototype' badge in the header/sidebar clearly but unobtrusively.
The primary interactive app flow must include a Dashboard-style left sidebar and a wide main content area. The AI assistant can be a right-side panel.
Make the horizontal timeline visually prominent in the Transfer Overview.
Adhere STRICTLY to the semantic color guidelines for PF status (Green=Verified/Success, Amber=Needs Attention/Processing, Red=Error).
Install `framer-motion` for subtle page transitions and timeline animations.
Ensure the Landing Page Hero uses high-fidelity UI previews, not generic illustrations.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Do NOT use emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, click states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use placeholder URLs (like placehold.it). Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their Tailwind classes to match the 'PF Resolve' brand.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
